design_description: A classic green-and-white striped design, using bold vertical bands across the front for a traditional football identity. The stripes feature subtle distressed breaks and worn detailing, giving the otherwise classic layout a more contemporary, handcrafted character. Solid green sleeves and collar frame the striped body, finished with clean white sleeve cuffs. The back shifts predominantly to solid green for maximum name-and-number visibility, with the vertical stripes returning around the lower hem. Overall, it combines a traditional striped kit with restrained distressed detailing and a clean modern finish.
